purpose: Links the SHA-256 each audit finds in evidence recorded on an earlier text of a listing to the listing now on disk, with the proof that the program is unchanged.

kinds.space-only: Stored spaces removed and nothing else: format198x-sinclair-zx-spectrum-bas 0.1.2, examples/tokenise_listing on both texts gives the earlier bytes with 0x20 removed, never in a string or after REM, hidden numbers unchanged. pre_listing_check repeats it with format198x-sinclair-zx-spectrum-bas at format198x caa48b3, which also stores a typed space before INK or TO where LIST prints one; those spaces are counted, not failed.
kinds.renamed-variable: The named variables renamed as whole words and nothing else. rom_boot is the genuine 48K ROM boot of tapes of both texts.
